name: insightbot
description: InSightBot - plataforma de endoscopia por capsula robotica para UBSs e clinicas

scripts.dev: npm run build:capsule && concurrently -n api,web -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev -w backend" "npm run dev -w frontend"
scripts.build: npm run build:capsule && npm run build -w frontend
scripts.test: npm run test -w backend && npm run test -w frontend
